verdict.rationale: The product is itself an official OpenAI SDK, shipped as first-party Python (github.com/openai/openai-agents-python) and JavaScript docs and packages. It has well-documented primitives (Runner, tools, handoffs, sessions, tracing), and community users report building with it hands-on. Missing for 10: no evidence of package installation or versioning docs, and no evidence of language coverage beyond Python and JS.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: It is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, as well as 100+ other LLMs.
Build text, sandbox, and voice agents with a small set of primitives.
You can run agents via the Runner class. You have 3 options: Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync(), Runner.run_streamed()
OpenAI SDK is much simpler to use and understand than langchain etc.
I'm about 2 hours in with the hands-on lab, using the OpenAI Agents SDK.
